title: Composition of exact ordinary restriction on the ordered finite Tate coefficient
statement: Let A be a commutative coefficient ring annihilated by N, and t the normalized ordinary finite twist transport of [def-asd-ordinary-finite-p1-arrows]. Let X be a scheme on which N is invertible, and U ⊆ V opens (with N invertible on V). For the ordered shifted Tate coefficient K_X(d) of [def-amb-vector-integration-charts], define τ_j as the inverse of the exact-to-left-derived pullback comparison followed by vectorIntegrationBaseCoefficientPullback. If c:R_i R_j ≅ R_k is the exact ordinary open compositor of [lem-pur-degree-zero-derived-map-gluing], where j:V→X, i:U→V and k:U→X, then c(K_X(d)) ≪≫ τ_k = R_i(τ_j) ≪≫ τ_i. The order of the Tate tensor factors is unchanged. This statement concerns only ordinary coefficient pullback and requires no dualizing object or site comparison.

proof.text: Induct on the ordered tensor degree. In degree zero apply ordinaryFiniteUnitPullback_comp, the proved composition equation for the actual constant-object comparison.

Identify each normalized roots map with the canonical roots pullback by cancellation of its monomorphic inclusion. Use the sheafification and scalar-extension adjunctions to identify maps from the finite Tate line with maps from roots into the underlying abelian sheaf. The line normalization identifies the adjoint of each line map on generators. The pullback adjunction composition equation and canonical roots composition therefore prove the line composition equation. Apply the degree-zero pullback comparison and shift compatibility. At each successor use the derived tensor pullback composition and naturality equations, the induction hypothesis, and this shifted-line equation.

Conjugate by the exact-to-left-derived comparison. Its naturality gives the exact ordinary derived compositor. Substitute homOfLE_ι to identify the composite open immersion and obtain openComp. This includes d=0, empty opens and zero coefficients.

theorem orderedTateExactOpenComposition (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] (N : ℕ)
    (hA : (N : A) = 0) (t : OrdinaryFiniteTwistTransport A N hA)
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (hX : IsUnit (N : Γ(X, ⊤))) (d : ℕ)
    {U V : X.Opens} (h : U ≤ V) (hV : IsUnit (N : Γ(V.toScheme, ⊤))) :
    let c := DegreeZeroMapGluing.openComp
      (fun T : Scheme.{u} ↦ Sheaf T.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A))
      (fun {_ _} j ↦ upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) j)
      (fun {_ _ _} i j ↦ upperStarComp (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) i j) X h
    c.app (affineLinearBaseCoefficient A N hA X d) ≪≫
        orderedTateExactPullback A N hA t U.ι hX d =
      (upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) (X.homOfLE h)).mapDerivedCategory.mapIso
          (orderedTateExactPullback A N hA t V.ι hX d) ≪≫
        orderedTateExactPullback A N hA t (X.homOfLE h) hV d
